result.detail: Decisions for the reviewer. (1) There is only one formal_spec, at WIDTH 8. The platform refuses more than one, so the plan's skid_buffer_w1.sby is not submitted, and WIDTH 1 relies on simulation alone. (2) The data registers load only when a beat is placed (m_data on m_free with a beat available, skid_data on a stall that accepts a beat) and are never reset, per the microarchitecture. (3) The testbench drives random garbage on s_data whenever the sender offers a beat that will not be accepted. This exercises the spec's rule that the sender need not hold its data while s_ready is low. (4) A beat offered during a reset cycle counts as not accepted, so the model drops it. (5) The testbench uses # delays, so a Verilator run needs --timing, plus --binary or --main for $value$plusargs.
